schemes.evidence: Transcribed from the council PDF titled 'Bootle Selective Licensing Boundary - List of included roads' (sefton.gov.uk/media/8194/sl-streets-2023-2028_r3.pdf), linked as 'List of streets included in the selective licensing area' from Sefton's Selective Licensing 2023-2028 page. The 11-page table gives each road with its ward (Derby, Linacre, Litherland) and any house-number restriction. The page states the designation ran from 1 March 2023 for five years to 29 February 2028, so this is the current schedule.
